$why: Where the transcribed folders meet texts already in print. Compared on 26 September 2026 by reading the Grothendieck Circle's published texts (and the Gille–Polo SGA 3) against the transcriptions — by machine, not by a specialist, so every edge is a lead to check, not a verdict. Only concrete links are drawn: a folder holding a draft of a published passage, a folder sharing specific statements with one, and a folder proving what the print only announces or leaves open. A shared subject alone is not an edge.

texts.title: La théorie des classes de Chern

links.note: The typescript of SGA 3 XII; his ink corrections are almost all in the printed text. His replacement sentence in Rem. 1.11 b) is not, and his « dans Exp XIII » at Th. 4.4 reads « XVII » in print.
Same statement and same proof: primary decomposition, polynomial functions, Engel.
An earlier, longer version of XIII §1: the general statements for G acting on V ⊃ W reappear in print only for V = G, W = H (XIII 2.1, 2.4, 2.5).
The semicontinuity inequalities X 8.7 states without proof — the editors' note asks for a reference — proved here through n-torsion and the Tate module.
His typescript pp. 26–32, numbered 3.x and saying « formellement simple » for smooth: an earlier version of the flat lift (19.7.1–19.7.2) and of Cohen algebras (19.8.1–19.8.2).
Deligne's letters of 1966 are the source of four printed errata to EGA IV; one leaf defines « essentiellement affine » as IV 8.13.4 does.
Jets, connexions of order n, infinitesimal transformations — what the opening of IV §16 says it passes over in silence.
Prop. 2.6 of the typescript is III 7.2.5 a)⇔b), in more general form.
« Notes pour Dieud. §9 »: the § 9 on relative and local cohomology and local duality that EGA III's printed summary announces and that was never published.
Limited families of sheaves and Chow's result: the same content, arranged differently, with proofs the talk only cites.
Pic⁰ of a projective abelian scheme is an abelian scheme — sketched in the talk, argued here through φ_L and Hopf.
Čech cohomology of a quasi-coherent sheaf along an fpqc covering is trivial.
The quasi-finite, non-finite case where the talk says « le conférencier ignore aussi la réponse ».
The equivalence stated there without proof for A local artinian — proved here, and generalised to the semi-local noetherian case.
Quotients by finite groups and the Künneth formula for π₁, the latter extended to a relative formula not in SGA 1.
Multigaloisian categories and a topos characterisation — what V 9 leaves « au lecteur ».
The coniveau filtration and spectral sequence, word for word (10.1, 10.3, 10.6); the notes add the motivic reading.
The form of the Hodge conjecture that the footnote of October 1968 declares false.
Crystalline and connecting topoi, the Chern class of a lifting; the divided-power version that the exposé leaves as a hope.
The λ-ring comparison and formula (16), stated in print without proof.
Weyl's and Horn's inequalities, quoted in print as known. PTT says he dropped this material from « La théorie de Fredholm ».
The inventory files this folder under Pursuing Stacks, whose edition by Maltsiniotis (vol. I, 2022) is in progress.
A draft of La Longue Marche, which Malgoire's edition covers in part.
